Takao Umehara · Creative Director · Design & AI Executiveクリエイティブディレクター · デザインと AI · New York ↔ Japanニューヨーク ↔ 日本

Creative leadership, across mediums媒体をまたいで、つくる

Different medium. Same instinct.媒体は違っても、勘は同じ。

A brand film told through real New York creatives. A room full of phones drawing on one wall. A festival rebuilt from scratch around games. A design organisation working with AI agents. They look unrelated. They are the same move: find the real question, make it tangible early, and let people react to it.ニューヨークのクリエイターたちが語るブランドフィルム。部屋中のスマホがひとつの壁に描く体験。ゲームを軸にゼロから作り直した祭り。AI エージェントと働くデザイン組織。無関係に見えて、動きは同じ。本当の問いを見つけ、早く形にして、人の反応を見る。

I like the beginning of things — the part where the idea is still soft and needs someone to make it real enough to react to.はじまりが好きだ。アイデアがまだ柔らかく、誰かが手で触れる形にしないと先へ進まない段階。

Experience · Brand · Operations · Revenue. One identity — the character 祭 and the school's motto 知行合一 — carried through logo, patterns, noren, signage, a treasure-card system that ties every booth together, and eleven games designed so that the rules can be learned by watching.体験・ブランド・運営・収益。「祭」の文字と校訓「知行合一」を軸にした。ロゴから暖簾、宝物カードまで 1 つの世界観で通し、見て分かる 11 のゲームを設計した。

What I did自分がしたこと

Global brandグローバルブランド

Coca-Cola — Global Visual DirectionsCoca-Cola — グローバルビジュアルディレクション

The Coca-Cola Company (via Ogilvy Brand Integration Group) · Senior Designer, Ogilvy Brand Integration Group

As Senior Designer at Ogilvy's Brand Integration Group, developed two parallel global visual directions for Coca-Cola: 'Coke-Animal World,' whimsical creatures built from bottle silhouettes including a giant-swan Times Square billboard, and 'SketchVibe World,' a hand-sketched aesthetic — deployed across billboards, vehicles, packaging, coolers and stationery internationally.Ogilvy のブランド統合チームで、Coca-Cola 向けに 2 つの世界観を作った。瓶の形から生まれた動物のキャラクター群と、手描きの絵柄。看板から便箋まで国際展開した。

What I did · what the team did自分がしたこと · チームがしたこと

What I did自分がしたこと

  • Developed two parallel global visual directions at Ogilvy's Brand Integration Group
  • Direction 1 'Coke-Animal World': whimsical creatures built from Coke bottle silhouettes, including a giant swan billboard in Times Square, deployed on billboards, buses and coolers
  • Direction 2 'SketchVibe World': a hand-sketched aesthetic applied to cans, letterhead, wall murals, transit lightboxes, coolers and vehicle wraps
  • Created the illustration systems behind both directions
  • Designed applications across consumer touchpoints — billboards, vehicles, packaging, environment, stationery

Kitadoko — Hair Salon RebrandingKitadoko — ヘアサロン・リブランディング

Kitadoko Hair Salon · Creative Director & Design Strategist Independent独立案件

Rebranded a 150-year-old underground family barbershop — 90% male clientele, zero repeat customers — into a modern salon for women and younger clients. Started with a business-model redesign anchored on the idea 'Kitadoko as a group of personal hair stylists,' then built identity, service flow and renovated interiors from it.150 年続く理容店は地下にあり、客の 9 割が男性でリピーターはゼロだった。まずロゴでなく事業の形から考え直した。「北床は専属美容師の集まり」という一言に軸を定め、内装まで作り直した。

What I did · what the team did自分がしたこと · チームがしたこと

What I did自分がしたこと

  • Ran an innovation bootcamp with the CEO and journey-mapped the business before any aesthetic work
  • Redesigned the business model around ongoing customer relationships rather than one-off haircuts
  • Anchored the strategy on the tagline 'Kitadoko as a group of personal hair stylists' — positioning the salon as people, not a place
  • Derived the identity, letterforms, service flow and renovated interior from that one idea
  • Led brand direction, business-model redesign, service design and visual identity

Reimagining how product teams make decisions with AIAI による UX ワークフローの変革

Verizon Value (6 brands) · Lead Product Designer (Agentic UX & AI Systems) · 2025–present

Working inside hard constraints — no custom models, no API access, Gemini and NotebookLM only — as a design brief. Agents authored as small filesystems of workflow, definition and knowledge files; Figma wired to code through MCP so prototypes stay on the real design system.独自モデルも API 接続もない制約を、設計条件にした。エージェントは手順・定義・知識の小さなファイル群として書いた。Figma は MCP でコードとつなぎ、試作が設計基盤から外れないようにした。

10
agents designed and shippedエージェント 10 体を実装
40+
designers using the agents利用デザイナー 40 人超
What I did · what the team did自分がしたこと · チームがしたこと

What I did自分がしたこと

  • 16+ one-hour interviews with designers and strategists; transcripts clustered with NotebookLM into a searchable pain map
  • Effort × impact × opportunity prioritisation and selection of bets with leadership
  • Designed and built all ten agents: Master Brain (3-layer project knowledge hub), Justin Case (edge-case detector), Sally (CX strategist / heuristic evaluator), the five-agent WDS studio, Clara (UX-writing evaluator), Alex (agent architect)
  • Authored agents as filesystems of workflow, definition and knowledge files; iterated each 'Gem' version after version
  • Wired Figma to VS Code via MCP so AI prototypes run on real design-system code
  • Weekly hands-on workshops for ~40 designers; every agent shared live

What the team didチームがしたこと

  • The XM product-strategy team took ownership of Master Brain and ran it across multiple real projects
  • Design leadership selected which bets to pilot
  • Designers, PMs, researchers and content people adopted the agents in their own projects

Career arcこれまでの流れ

Twenty years, one instinct. The mediums changed; the move — find the real question, make it tangible, let people react — did not.20年、ひとつの勘。媒体は変わっても、本当の問いを見つけ、形にして、人の反応を見るという動きは変わらなかった。

  1. Brandブランド

    Global brand work at Ogilvy and a run of identity, book and campaign projects. Learning that a brand is a decision about what something is for.Ogilvy でのグローバルブランド案件と、ロゴ・書籍・キャンペーンの仕事群。ブランドとは何のためにあるかを決めることだと学んだ。

    • Ogilvy Brand Integration Group Senior Designer

  2. Interactiveインタラクティブ

    Experiences where the input is a body, a voice or a room full of phones. The instinct that runs through everything after: make it, then see what people do.入力が身体・声・部屋いっぱいのスマホになる体験づくり。作ってから人の反応を見るという勘は、この先ずっと変わらない。

  3. Product / EdTechプロダクト / EdTech

    Leading product design at Amplify — AR-powered literacy quests reaching millions of students — and a string of education and productivity products.Amplify でプロダクトデザインを率いた。AR を使った読解クエストは数百万人の生徒に届き、教育・業務効率化のプロダクトが続いた。

    • Amplify Education Product Design Lead

  4. Enterprise / CXエンタープライズ / CX

    Banks, telecoms and retail: design systems at scale, live-coded prototypes as the spec, and the customer experience across digital and physical.銀行・通信・小売。大規模なデザインシステムと、仕様書代わりのライブコード試作、デジタルと店舗をまたぐ顧客体験を手がけた。

    • Concentrix Catalyst Lead Product Designer
    • Creativity Is Everywhere LLC Founder

  5. AI / VenturesAI / ベンチャー

    AI agents inside a locked-down enterprise, a design language for agentic products, open-source tools, and a portfolio of ventures at the validating stage.制約の強い企業に組み込む AI エージェント、AI が介在するプロダクトの設計言語、オープンソースのツール、そして検証段階のベンチャー群。

    • Verizon Value Lead Product Designer (Agentic UX & AI Systems)2024–present
    • intentfirst.ai Founder
